en.title: An Archaeology and Ancient Capitals Route in China
en.headline: China's Archaeology Route: Follow Changing Capitals, Not a List of Dynasties
en.description: Build a focused Xi'an–Luoyang–Anyang archaeology route by changing evidence types, with optional extensions only when they add a new question.

zh.title: 中国考古与古都主题路线
zh.headline: 中国考古路线：追随都城与证据变化，不背朝代表
zh.description: 按不同证据类型建设西安—洛阳—安阳考古主轴，只有增加新问题时才延伸。
